items.q: With Eugene Coy's band, and we got a call from Dallas, Texas from a man by the name of T. H. Smith.

ctx.x: With Eugene Coy's band, and we got a

call from Dallas, Texas from a man by the name of T. H. Smith. Now T. H. Smith was a very rich real estate man, and he owned the North Dallas club. Milt, I'm sure you're familiar with the North Dallas Club.
